pages.text: Build a closed box of side 5 or 7 with Reactor Shell, place the controller and ports on walls, and put 1 core, fuel rods (<=10) and coolers (<=20) inside.$(br)Fuel cells burn at peak output between 400-700C.
Fuel rods unlock fuel slots; coolers need a heat sink inside and must touch a rod to work.$(br)Above 850C output drops; at 1000C the reactor explodes after 10 seconds - keep it cool!
